name: Little de Bitch! ~Koakuma na Imouto~
original_name: リトルdeびっち！～小悪魔な妹～
source:
I'm a lolicon, a normal boy whose daily routine is to buy junior idol merchandise and use it as wank material.
Then, one day, I suddenly got a little sister.

Her name is Seara.
I thought I was about to have the best life with a little sister, but Seara is a total bitch and it was far from what I had imagined.

She didn't recognize me as her brother and treated me like a stranger.

But through all that, I secretly had feelings for Seara's friend, Momoka.

Little by little, Seara began to realize my feelings for Momoka.

One day, Seara saw me masturbating with Momoka's panties.

Now she had a hold on me. From then on, Seara started to force me to buy Momoka's goods, and then she began doing strange things like using them to play with me.

Eventually her play got increasingly more intense.
But what exactly is Seara's purpose? I feel anxious every day because I can't see what the future holds. Will the day come when I can be united with Momoka?
And what will our fate be?

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160311232922/http://100kcal.info/games/ritodebi/story.html]Official website[/url]]
translation:
我是一个萝莉控，一个普通的男孩子，每天的日常就是购买少年偶像周边商品，然后用它来作为自慰材料。
然后，有一天，我突然多了一个妹妹。

她的名字叫塞拉。
我以为我会和一个小妹妹过上最好的生活，但塞拉就是个彻头彻尾的婊子，这与我的想象相去甚远。

她不承认我是她的兄弟，并把我当作陌生人一样对待。

但经过这一切，我暗自对塞拉的朋友桃花产生了感情。

渐渐地，塞拉开始意识到我对桃花的感情。

有一天，Seara看到我用Momoka的内裤自慰。

现在她控制住了我。从那时起，Seara开始强迫我买Momoka的商品，然后她开始做一些奇怪的事情，比如用它们来玩我。

最终她的比赛变得越来越激烈。
但Seara的目的到底是什么？我每天都感到焦虑，因为我看不到未来。我和桃花能在一起的那一天会到来吗？
而我们的命运又会怎样呢？

[来自[url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160311232922/http://100kcal.info/games/ritodebi/story.html]官网[/url]]
